journal.text: Watched EVO tonight. 🇯🇵 The Abacus lifted it. One day that stage hears MY name and the rest of this is just the road there.
Won Weekly. Felt correct. Next.
EmptyJump again. Every bracket, every time, closer than I'll say out loud. Fine. If the game insists on giving me a rival, I'll make it a famous one.
Anansi kept demanding temperance and tonight I finally answered. The character shapes the player. Fine — shape me into a weapon.
Fixed it. The thing that kept costing me — analysis — it's mine now. Run it back, all of you.
FreeWins again. Every bracket, every time, closer than I'll say out loud. Fine. If the game insists on giving me a rival, I'll make it a famous one.
I beat Perihelion. WORLD-RANKED Perihelion. Read it back. Read it again. Everything before tonight was practice.
Started working with RawSuper. Watching someone light up when a concept lands — that might be better than winning.
They buffed Anansi. Whoever was ducking me before should think very carefully about their schedule now.
Watched EVO tonight. 🇯🇵 The Abacus lifted it. One day that stage hears MY name and the rest of this is just the road there.
Sharper. loyalty was already my blade and today it went to a new level. They should worry.

Wearing Neon Society's tag tonight for the first time. It's three letters and it changes how the whole room says my name.
Money match, FreeWins, settled. My pocket and my point both heavier.
temperance clicked, and if I'm honest it's NS | MixupCity's fault. Fine. FINE. Thanks.
The room's already calling me-and-TheReads a thing. Good. I play better with someone to beat.

Took Weekly. The bracket played out almost exactly as mapped — almost. The 'almost' goes in the notes.
The ButtonCheck series has become its own subject. I keep a page just for them now. Iron sharpens iron — and I brought a whetstone.
Lost the money match to ButtonCheck. Paying up in front of everyone is a specific kind of education.
Losing streak, statistically undeniable now. Cataloguing everything — food, sleep, warmups. Something changed and I will find it.
